target: A formidable Mutant Organism that appears in the deep of Dim Forest. Leader of the Hoochiefs.

source: Um mecha negro e silencioso, perdido e ansiando por voltar para casa.
target: A wordless black mech, lost and longing to return home.

source: Um membro da gangue clandestina de Ragunna.
target: A member of the Ragunna underground gang.

source: Um membro dos Patrulheiros da Meia-noite.
target: A member of the Midnight Rangers.

source: Um misterioso Exoenxame em forma de raptor que parece imitar um antigo animal extinto.
target: A mysterious raptor-shaped Exoswarm that seems to mimic an extinct ancient animal.

source: Um raptor poderoso que se acreditava estar extinto, agora aparecendo dentro da Câmara de Vida Upphaf.
target: A powerful raptor believed to be extinct, now appearing within the Upphaf Life Chamber.

source: Um robô de exploração desenvolvido pelo Coletivo da Jornada Espacial. Ágil e veloz, adapta-se perfeitamente ao terreno acidentado de Lahai-Roi.
target: An exploration robot developed by the Spacetrek Collective. Agile and nimble, it perfectly suits Lahai-Roi's rugged terrain.

source: Um robô desenvolvido pelo Coletivo da Jornada Espacial, que vem nas variantes: corpo a corpo e à distância. Os dois modelos lutam graciosamente em sincronia quando pareados.
target: A mech developed by the Spacetrek Collective, which comes in melee and ranged variants. The two models fight gracefully in unison when paired.

source: Um robô grande e veloz desenvolvido pelo Coletivo da Jornada Espacial para transporte e defesa.
target: A large, fast-moving mech developed by the Spacetrek Collective for both transport and defense.

source: Um ser adormecido sob o oceano, os restos acinzentados de uma glória há muito consumida.
target: A being slumbering beneath the ocean, the ashen remains of a glory long burned out.

source: Um tipo de DT Murmurim eletromagnética robusta que atrai metal para formar uma carapaça protetora. Arcos voltaicos são quase imperceptíveis através das rachaduras em sua armadura metálica.
target: A type of ironclad electromagnetic Murmurin TD that attracts metal to form a protective shell around itself. Electric arcs are faintly visible through cracks in its metallic armor.

source: Um vestígio ancestral sepultado sob o permafrost, prisioneiro por suas próprias mãos.
target: An ancient remnant entombed under the permafrost, a prisoner by its own hand.

source: Uma DS que imita rochas e carrega Calcita-ressonante. A Energia Remanente que flui em seu interior brilha com um fulgor nacarado.
target: A rpck-mimic TD that carries Resonant Calcite. The Remnant Energy flowing inside shimmers with a pearly glow.

source: Uma DT humanoide graciosa vestida de gelo.
target: A graceful humanoid TD dressed in ice.

source: Uma DT que imita rochas com Ouro-de-tolo nas costas. É frequentemente confundida com minério de ouro não extraído.
target: A rock-mimic TD with Fool's Gold on its back. It is often mistaken for unmined gold ore.

source: Uma DT que imita um filhote de draco, com rajadas de vento girando entre suas garras. Frequentemente encontrado vivendo em grupos na natureza selvagem.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with gusts of wind swirling between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Uma DT que imita um filhote de dragão, com faíscas de raio piscando entre suas garras. Frequentemente encontrada vivendo em grupos na natureza.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with sparks of thunder flashing between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Uma DT que imita um filhote de dragão, com gelo e geada se formando entre suas garras. Frequentemente encontrada vivendo em grupos na natureza.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with ice and frost forming between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Uma DT uivante, terrestre de classe comum. Seu tamanho dita seu poder limitado.
target: A common Class, terrestrial, Howler TD. Its size dictates its limited power.

source: Uma DT única, semelhante a uma mariposa, endêmico das Planícies de Dimmr, frequentemente visto em áreas altamente contaminadas por Matéria do Vazio.
target: A unique, moth-like TD endemic to the Dimmr Plains, often seen in areas heavily contaminated by Voidmatter.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora de Pesadelo que está caçando Lucy. A torrente de dados que reveste seu corpo embaralha os radares locais e oferece imunidade contra a maioria dos ataques de Ressonantes.
target: A Nightmare Tacet Discord that is hunting Lucy down. The data torrent that envelopes its body scrambles sensors and offers immunity to most attacks from Resonators.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora de Pesadelo que está caçando Lucy. Ela pode se mover entre as fissuras de dados.
target: A Nightmare Tacet Discord that is hunting down Lucy. It can traverse between data rifts.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora especial invocada por Phrolova de uma Esfera Sonora onde todas as frequências em decadência convergem, conhecida como "Além". Manifesta-se como uma Bruxa do Submundo de três faces.
target: A special Tacet Discord summoned by Phrolova from a Sonoro Sphere where all decaying frequencies converge, known as the "Beyond." It manifests as a three-faced Witch of the Underworld.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora especial que espreita na rede intricada dos Nós da Paisagem Onírica.
target: A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora especial que se esconde na rede intricada dos Nodos de Paisagem Onírica.
target: A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora especial que se esconde na rede intricada dos Nós da Paisagem Onírica.
target: A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora especial que se esconde na rede intricada dos Nós da Paisagem Onírica. Ela reúne frequências de uma emoção negativa específica.
target: A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes. It gathers frequencies of a particular negative emotion.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora especial que se esconde na rede intrincada dos Nós da Paisagem Onírica.
target: A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora humanoide curvada, com correntes voltaicas percorrendo suas veias e um chicote saindo da cabeça.
target: A bent-over humanoid Tacet Discord with electric currents coursing through its veins and a whip-like appendage on its head.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora humanoide sem rosto com um corpo que flui, se divide e se funde como uma sombra viva.
target: A faceless humanoid Tacet Discord with a body that flows, splits, and coalesces like a living shadow.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora que ataca alvos à distância dentro do Campo de Dissonância.
target: A Tacet Discord that attacks targets at range within the Tacet Field.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora que entra em combate corpo a corpo dentro do Campo de Dissonância.
target: A Tacet Discord that engages in close combat within the Tacet Field.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora que imita um filhote de draco, com chamas ardendo entre suas garras, frequentemente encontrada vivendo em grupos na natureza selvagem.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with flame blazing between its claws, often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora que imita um filhote de draco, com luz pulsando entre suas garras. Frequentemente encontrada vivendo em grupos na natureza selvagem.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with light pulsating between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Uma Dissonância Transgressora que imita um filhote de draco, com torrentes sombrias se espalhando entre suas garras. Frequentemente encontrada vivendo em grupos na natureza selvagem.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with ominous torrents sprawling between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Uma abelha mecânica, criada a partir de peças do Exotitã. Os royanos costumam usá-las como ferramentas para coletar minerais frágeis em espaços apertados.
target: A mechanical bumblebee, grown from the Exostrider's own parts. The Roya often use them as tools to collect fragile minerals from cramped spaces.

source: Uma abelha mecânica, criada a partir de peças do Exotitã. Os royanos costumam usá-las para coletar pólen e néctar de plantas.
target: A mechanical bumblebee, grown from the Exostrider's own parts. The Roya often use them as tools to collect pollen and plant nectar.

source: Uma carapaça humanoide formada de lodo negro. Ela ocupa seu lugar entre as presas, aguardando pacientemente os caçadores que foi criada para devorar.
target: A humanoid shell formed of black sludge. It takes its place among the prey, patiently awaiting the hunters it was made to devour.

source: Uma criatura parasita que vive dentro das Dissonâncias Transgressoras Sussurro. Usa o corpo do hospedeiro como casulo e se alimenta de sua frequência.
target: A parasitic creature that lives inside Whisperin Tacet Discords. It uses the host's body as a cocoon and feeds on its frequency.

source: Uma criação do Fractiverso. Uma falha defeituosa abandonada nas sombras.
target: A creation of the Fractsidus. A defective failure abandoned to the shadows.

source: Uma criação valiosa do Fractiverso, fundindo um chapéu ornamental com a essência de uma Dissonância Transgressora e tecnologias da Nova Federação.
target: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a picture hat with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.

source: Uma criação valiosa do Fractiverso, fundindo um par de mangas flutuantes com a essência de uma Dissonância Transgressora usando tecnologias da Nova Federação.
target: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a pair of flowing sleeves with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.

source: Uma criação valorizada do Fractiverso, que funde um conjunto de garras cruéis com a essência de uma Dissonância Transgressora usando tecnologias da Nova Federação.
target: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a set of vicious claws with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.

source: Uma figura mecânica misteriosa que caminha pelo alto dos céus. A própria personificação do ápice da Mecânica Cibernética.
target: A mystic Autopuppet that strolls in the sky. An epitome of mechanist arts at their peak.

source: Uma forma especial de um dos Supervisores do Fractiverso. Essa monstruosidade empunha uma foice negra como breu que corta através da ordem e da lei.
target: A special form of one of the Fractsidus Overseers. Such monstrosity wields pitch-black scythe that cleaves through order and law.

source: Uma máquina capaz de camuflagem. Possui sentidos aguçados e usa o detector em sua cauda para rastrear movimentos do inimigo.
target: A machine capable of camouflage. It possesses heightened senses and uses the detector on its tail to track enemy movements.

source: Uma máquina predatória muito agressiva que ronda os ermos de Lahai-Roi, caçando tudo que se mover.
target: A highly aggressive predatory machine that prowls the wilderness of Lahai-Roi, hunting any sign of movement.

source: Uma poderosa Dissonância Transgressora que reside nos poços profundos da Fauce do Tigre. Há muito poucos relatos de avistamentos disponíveis, mas afirmam que se assemelham a insetos.
target: A powerful Tacet Discord that resides in the deep shafts of the Tiger's Maw. There is very few available sighting reports, and the only ones claim that they resemble insects.

source: Uma rena mecânica, criada a partir de peças do Exotitã. Os royanos costumam usá-las para ajudar na coleta de plantas.
target: A mechanical reindeer, grown from the Exostrider's own parts. They often help the Roya in plant foraging.

source: Uma rena mecânica, criada a partir de peças do Exotitã. Os royanos costumam usá-las para ajudar na mineração.
target: A mechanical reindeer, grown from the Exostrider's own parts. They often help the Roya in ore mining.

source: Uma sombra gigante arruinada à espreita na Oficina Celeste. Ela foi quase esquecida, mas ainda se agarra à diretriz de exterminar as Dissonâncias Transgressoras até o amargo fim.
target: A ruined giant shadow lurking within the Skyworks. It has nearly been forgotten, yet still clings to the directive to wipe out the Tacet Discords to the bitter end.

source:
Umkehr
Wird diese Tacet-Dissonanz verlangsamt, erhöht sich stattdessen ihre Bewegungsgeschwindigkeit.
target:
Reversal
When Slowed, this Tacet Discord moves faster instead.

source: Un Artisan de Fractsidus. Une variation soudaine a figé son corps, et sa forme est désormais altérée après avoir traversé le chaos des profondeurs.
target: Fractsidus gunners whose flesh turned cold when fate struck a discordant chord. After losing control in the depths of the sea, they can never return to their former selves.

source: Un Artífice de Fractsidus, congelado por una repentina variación. Tras perder el control en las profundidades del mar, jamás pudieron recuperar su antigua forma.
target: Fractsidus gunners whose flesh turned cold when fate struck a discordant chord. After losing control in the depths of the sea, they can never return to their former selves.

source: Un Aullido DT de Clase común que a menudo se encuentra flotando en la naturaleza. Su poder es insignificante.
target: A Common Class Howler TD often found floating in the wild. Its power is puny.

source: Un Aullido de Clase común DT a menudo avistado en aguas poco profundas. A juzgar por los registros de ataque a humanos por iniciativa propia, podría tener un temperamento bastante irritable.
target: A Common Class Howler TD often sighted in shallow waters. Judging from the records of charging humans on its own initiative, it might have a rather irritable temper.

source: Un Aullido de Clase común DT a menudo avistado en áreas montañosas. Usualmente sigue y trabaja en concierto con Disonancias Tácitas de tamaños más grandes.
target: A Common Class Howler TD often sighted in mountainous areas. It usually follows and works in concert with Tacet Discords of larger sizes.

source: Un Aullido de Clase común DT ampliamente distribuido en áreas de agua. Su tamaño es relativamente pequeño.
target: A Common Class Howler TD widely distributed in water areas. Its size is relatively small.

source: Un Aullido de Clase común DT que vive en ambientes oscuros. Los Registros muestran que posee una impresionante habilidad de contraataque.
target: A Common Class Howler TD living in obscured environments. Records show that it possesses an impressive counterattack ability.

source: Un Aullido de Clase común y DT activo en el agua. Destaca en el camuflaje y en ataques sorpresa a enemigos cercanos.
target: A Common Class Howler TD active in water. It excels at disguising and sneaking attacks on nearby enemies.

source: Un Eco parecido a una estatua que simboliza la misericordia y la compasión, siempre escuchando las oraciones y alabanzas de los raguneses a la Orden.
target: A statue-like Echo that symbolizes mercy and compassion, always listening to Ragunnesi's prayers and praises to the Order.

source: Un Eco que empuña un arco, semejante a una estatua, encargado de vigilar la Ciudad de Raguna y reportar los detalles a la Orden.
target: A bow-wielding Echo that resembles a statue, tasked with monitoring Ragunna City and reporting the details back to the Order.

source: Un Eco que empuña una espada, semejante a una estatua silenciosa y severa, está encargado de proteger la paz y la seguridad de la Ciudad de Raguna en nombre de la Orden.
target: A sword-wielding Echo that resembles a silent and stern statue, tasked with protecting Ragunna City's peace and safety for the Order.

source: Un Inspecteur des Fractsidus. Son corps profondément altéré est la marque qu'il a obtenue au prix de son chemin vers l'idéal.
target: Inspectors of the Fractsidus who wear the tendrils of darkness emanating from their highly modified body like a badge of honor.

source: Un TD Aullido de Clase de élite que vive de manera nómada a través del Bosque Oscuro. Los individuos viven en manadas. Los Registros muestran que esta DT es conflictivo y propenso a robar objetos humanos.
target: An Elite Class Howler TD living nomadically across Dim Forest. Individuals live in packs. Records show that this TD is fractious and prone to stealing human objects.

source: Un TD particulier qui se dissimule dans le réseau des nœuds oniriques.
target: A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes.

source: Un TD qui apparaît aux Hauts des roches. Très cruel, il attaque les ennemis sans hésitation. Niveau de danger : Marée.
target: An Overlord Class Howler TD showing up in Desorock Highland. It is known to be ferocious and highly aggresive.

source: Un TD qui apparaît dans la mer. Il est dit qu'il hurle comme la Baleine. Niveau de danger : Marée.
target: A Calamity Class Howler TD under the depths of the seas. Melodies produced by it were recorded and found to resemble whalesongs.

source: Un TD qui imite la forme d'un petit dragon avec des bourrasques de vent tourbillonnant entre ses griffes, souvent trouvé vivant en groupe dans la nature.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with gusts of wind swirling between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Un TD qui imite la forme d'un petit dragon avec des glaces entre ses griffes, souvent trouvé vivant en groupe dans la nature.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with ice and frost forming between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Un TD qui imite la forme d'un petit dragon avec des éclairs de tonnerre scintillant entre ses griffes, souvent trouvé vivant en groupe dans la nature.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with sparks of thunder flashing between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Un Tacet Discord Murmurin blindé électromagnétique qui attire les métaux pour se créer une coque protectrice. Des arcs électriques sont visibles à travers les fissures de son armure métallique.
target: A type of ironclad electromagnetic Murmurin TD that attracts metal to form a protective shell around itself. Electric arcs are faintly visible through cracks in its metallic armor.

source: Un Tacet Discord d'ours féroce, dont les coups s'abattent avec la violence d'une tempête.
target: A ferocious bear-mimic TD with great strength, swinging with hurricane-like force.

source: Un Tacet Discord de cauchemar qui traque Lucy. Il a la capacité de traverser les failles de données.
target: A Nightmare Tacet Discord that is hunting down Lucy. It can traverse between data rifts.

source: Un Tacet Discord de cauchemar qui traque Lucy. Le torrent de données qui enveloppe son corps brouille les systèmes de détection locaux et lui offre une immunité contre la plupart des attaques des résonateurs.
target: A Nightmare Tacet Discord that is hunting Lucy down. The data torrent that envelopes its body scrambles sensors and offers immunity to most attacks from Resonators.

source: Un Tacet Discord de minéral commun, dégageant un courant d'énergie intense.
target: A mineral TD commonly found in mine veins, filled with powerful air currents.

source: Un Tacet Discord de sculpture mimétique, symbolisant la déconstruction et la reconstruction, aux mouvements lourds et lents.
target: A stone statue TD that embodies deconstruction and reconstruction. Its movements are sluggish and clumsy.

source: Un Tacet Discord en forme d'oiseau dans le Trépas du pénitent. Il est capable d'effacer toute trace de son corps dans l'obscurité profonde, ne laissant que son masque enflammé flotter comme le feu follet dans la légende.
target: An avian Tacet Discord prowling the Penitent's End. In darkness, its form blends into shadow, leaving only its mask flickering like ignis fatuus.

source: Un Tacet Discord humanoïde formé par des vitraux brisés d'anciennes ruines. Ses mouvements projettent constamment des éclats de lumière éblouissants.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord with a body assembled from shattered stained glass. Glittering lights beam from its body with each move.

source: Un Tacet Discord humanoïde portant un drapé de glace comme une jupe flottante, se déplaçant avec légèreté et grâce.
target: A graceful humanoid TD dressed in ice.

source: Un Tacet Discord humanoïde sans visage, dont le corps ondule, se divise et se transforme tel une ombre vivante.
target: A faceless humanoid Tacet Discord with a body that flows, splits, and coalesces like a living shadow.

source: Un Tacet Discord humanoïde. Vêtu d'un habit somptueux et armé d'une lame acérée, il n'apparaît que sous la lueur lunaire.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade. Seen only in the pale glow of the moon.

source: Un Tacet Discord humanoïde. Vêtu d'un habit somptueux et armé d'une lame acérée, n'apparaissant que sous la brillance solaire.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade. Seen only in the radiance of the sun.

source: Un Tacet Discord humanoïde. Vêtu d'un habit somptueux et armé d'une lame acérée, sa force légendaire rivalise avec les héros des mythes anciens.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade and extraordinary might existing only in legends.

source: Un Tacet Discord né des profondeurs abyssales. Sa forme, pleinement évoluée de la Fleur primordiale, ressemble à l'apparence d'un aristocrate.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord born from the abyssal sea that assumes the semblance of an aristocrat, a fully differentiated form of Primordia Bloom.

source: Un Tacet Discord né des profondeurs abyssales. Sa forme, pleinement évoluée de la Fleur primordiale, ressemble à l'apparence d'un commerçant aristocrate.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord born from the abyssal sea that assumes the semblance of an aristocratic merchant, a fully differentiated form of Primordia Bloom.

source: Un Tacet Discord né des profondeurs abyssales. Sa forme, pleinement évoluée de la Fleur primordiale, ressemble à l'apparence d'un garde aristocrate.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord born from the abyssal sea that assumes the semblance of an aristocratic knight, a fully differentiated form of Primordia Bloom.

source: Un Tacet Discord particulier qui se dissimule dans le réseau des nœuds oniriques, concentrant les fréquences de certaines émotions négatives.
target: A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes. It gathers frequencies of a particular negative emotion.

source: Un Tacet Discord particulier qui se dissimule dans le réseau des nœuds oniriques.
target: A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes.

source: Un Tacet Discord qui imite un petit dragon, avec de la lumière scintillant entre ses griffes. Souvent trouvé vivant en groupes dans la nature.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with light pulsating between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Un Tacet Discord qui imite un petit dragon, avec des flammes qui embrasent ses griffes. Souvent trouvé vivant en groupes dans la nature.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with flame blazing between its claws, often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Un Tacet Discord qui imite un petit dragon, avec des torrents sombres se formant entre ses griffes. Souvent trouvé vivant en groupes dans la nature.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with ominous torrents sprawling between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Un Tacet Discord qui lance des attaques de mêlées dans la Zone taciturne.
target: A Tacet Discord that engages in close combat within the Tacet Field.

source: Un Tacet Discord qui lance toujours ses attaques depuis l'extérieur des Zones taciturnes.
target: A Tacet Discord that attacks targets at range within the Tacet Field.

source: Un Tacet Discord sans forme qui parasite une peluche, prenant une apparence robuste et appliquée.
target: An incorporeal Tacet Discord inhabiting the body of a sturdy, diligent plushie.

source: Un Tacet Discord sans forme qui parasite une peluche, prenant une apparence silencieuse mais attentive.
target: An incorporeal Tacet Discord inhabiting the body of a quiet, compassionate plushie.

source: Un Tacet Discord sans forme qui parasite une peluche, prenant une apparence usée et effrayante.
target: An incorporeal Tacet Discord inhabiting the body of a large, ragged stuffed toy.

source: Un Tacet Discord sans forme qui parasite une peluche, prenant une apparence élégante et pleine d'humour.
target: An incorporeal Tacet Discord inhabiting the body of a charming, dashing plushie.

source: Un Tacet Discord servant de main droite à « Hache hache ».
target: A Tacet Discord that functions as the "right hand" of Chop Chop.

source: Un Tacet Discord servant de main gauche à « Hache hache ».
target: A Tacet Discord that functions as the "left hand" of Chop Chop.

source: Un Tacet Discord servant de tête à « Hache hache ».
target: A Tacet Discord that functions as the "head" of Chop Chop.

source: Un Tacet Discord sous l'apparence de « Coffre de provision premium », attirant et dévorant tous ceux qui convoitent ce trésor mystérieux.
target: A deceptive Tacet Discord disguised as a supply chest, preying on the greed of its victims and devouring those who approach.

source: Un Tacet Discord souvent aperçu planant au sommet des grandes structures, adoptant une posture imposante comme si les bâtiments faisaient partie intégrante de son corps. Sa silhouette fusionne avec l'architecture, dressée tel un géant menaçant.
target: A Tacet Discord often seen hovering atop large structures, feigning an imposing posture as if the buildings are extensions of its body. Its silhouette blends with the architecture, towering like a menacing giant.

source: Un Tacet Discord terrestre d'Hurleur. Il a des ailes mais ne peut pas voler et il ne supporte pas le froid. Niveau de dangeer : Onde.
target: A Common Class Howler TD. Despite its wings, it is entirely terrestrial and highly sensitive to the cold.

source: Un Tacet Discord unique qui ressemble à un papillon nocturne souvent présent dans les zones corrompues par les Matières du néant aux Plaines de Dimmr.
target: A unique, moth-like TD endemic to the Dimmr Plains, often seen in areas heavily contaminated by Voidmatter.

source: Un Tacet Discord à l'apparence de loup, errant sans relâche dans les terres frappées par la foudre, connu pour sa violence dévastatrice et sa rapidité fulgurante.
target: A wolf-like Tacet Discord prowling storm-stricken regions, known for its aggressiveness and lightning speed.

source: Un Tacet Discord à l'apparence de loup, errant sans relâche dans les terres gelées, connu pour sa froideur implacable et sa nature sanguinaire.
target: A wolf-like Tacet Discord ravaging frostbitten regions, known for its cold-blooded and ruthless nature.

source: Un Tacet Discord à l'apparence de loup, errant sans relâche sur les régions d'altitude élevée, connu pour sa soif de chasse et sa nature inépuisable.
target: A wolf-like Tacet Discord dominating high-altitude regions, notorious for its relentless predation.

source: Un Títere gigantesco que absorbió estructuras del Tribunal Censor. Las almas atadas a antiguos campos de batalla depositan sus miradas sobre los enemigos que tengan enfrente, contra los que blanden sus espadas.
target: A giant Autopuppet that has absorbed structures of Censure Courts. The strong obsessions that bind it can be felt by those who confront it.

source: Un Títere gigantesco que absorbió estructuras del Tribunal Censor. Las almas atadas a antiguos campos de batalla depositan sus miradas sobre los enemigos que tengan enfrente, contra los que blanden sus espadas.
target: A massive Autopuppet formed by absorbing the buildings of the Censure Court, bound by the battlefields of old, and bringing down merciless blades upon the enemies before it.

source: Un Títere menor del Tribunal Censor. Especializado en desempeñar labores de patrulla e investigación.
target: Within the Censure Court, there seems to be an Autopuppet that is relatively small in size, tasked with surveillance and patrol.

source: Un Títere versátil que alberga emociones a montones. Recorre la tierra de Xuanfang cambiando de forma constantemente, siguiendo la orden de eliminar Disonancias Tácitas.
target: A versatile Autopuppet that carries an abundance of emotions. It traverses the Land of Xuanfang in ever-changing forms, carrying out the command to wipe out Tacet Discords.

source: Un antiguo resto sepultado y sellado bajo la tierra helada. Prisionero por elección propia.
target: An ancient remnant entombed under the permafrost, a prisoner by its own hand.

source: Un arma artificial completamente equipada, creada específicamente para el combate. Es un Eco modificado mediante una técnica especial.
target: A precise and powerful battle machine that has been refitted with special technology. It carries out its master's commands with absolute loyalty.

source: Un automate bestial dissimulé dans la brume. Il ressemble à une bête divine chassant le mal, rôdant dans la brume à l'affût d'une occasion d'attaquer.
target: An Autopuppet bearing the body of a beast shrouded in fog. Like the legendary beast that fends off evil, it roams with the fog, awaiting its chance to strike.

source: Un automate bestial dissimulé dans la brume. Il ressemble à une bête divine chassant le mal, rôdant dans la brume à l'affût d'une occasion d'attaquer.
target: An Autopuppet bearing the form of a beast shrouded in fog. Like the legendary beast that fends off evil, it roams with the fog, awaiting its chance to strike.

source: Un automate bestial dissimulé dans la brume. Il ressemble à une bête divine chassant le mal, rôdant dans la brume à l'affût d'une occasion d'attaquer.
target: An Autopuppet bearing the head of a beast shrouded in fog. Like the legendary beast that fends off evil, it roams with the fog, awaiting its chance to strike.

source: Un automate commun qui a des sentiments très riches. Il parcourt les Terres de Xuanfang sous différentes formes, avec pour mission de repousser les monstres.
target: A versatile Autopuppet that carries an abundance of emotions. It traverses the Land of Xuanfang in ever-changing forms, carrying out the command to wipe out Tacet Discords.

source: Un automate géant qui a absorbé les structures de la cour de détention. Quiconque l'affronte peut ressentir la puissance des obsessions qui le lient.
target: A giant Autopuppet that has absorbed structures of Censure Courts. The strong obsessions that bind it can be felt by those who confront it.

source: Un automate mystérieux qui déambule dans les airs. L'incarnation même de l'art mécaniste à son apogée.
target: A mystic Autopuppet that strolls in the sky. An epitome of mechanist arts at their peak.

source: Un bourdon mécanique, conçu à partir des propres pièces d'Exoarpenteur. Les Royans l'utilisent comme outils pour récolter le pollen et le nectar des plantes.
target: A mechanical bumblebee, grown from the Exostrider's own parts. The Roya often use them as tools to collect pollen and plant nectar.

source: Un bourdon mécanique, conçu à partir des propres pièces d'Exoarpenteur. Les Royans l'utilisent fréquemment comme outils pour récolter des minéraux fragiles dans des espaces restreints.
target: A mechanical bumblebee, grown from the Exostrider's own parts. The Roya often use them as tools to collect fragile minerals from cramped spaces.

source: Un buey mecánico nacido de partes del Exotitán. Suele acompañar a los royas cuando transportan cargas pesadas.
target: A mechanical muskox, grown from the Exostrider's own parts. They often help the Roya in transporting loads.

source: Un composant situé à l'intérieur du réacteur. Lorsque le mécanisme de défense est activé, le programme de combat se déclenche pour éliminer l'intrus.
target: A Reactor Drive component. When the Drive's immune response is triggered, its battle logic will activate to eliminate all intruders.

source: Un felino mecánico capaz de camuflarse. Se vale de sus agudos sentidos y del sensor de su cola para rastrear los movimientos del enemigo.
target: A machine capable of camouflage. It possesses heightened senses and uses the detector on its tail to track enemy movements.

source: Un formidable Organismo mutante que aparece en lo profundo del Bosque Oscuro. Líder de los Jefemicos.
target: A formidable Mutant Organism that appears in the deep of Dim Forest. Leader of the Hoochiefs.

source: Un gladiador de Septimont que lucha sin cadenas ni clemencia, es leal a la voluntad de la libertad.
target: Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, embodying the will of freedom.

source: Un gladiador de Septimont que lucha sin cadenas ni clemencia, es leal a su lucha eterna.
target: Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, embodying a warrior's undying passion.

source: Un gladiador de Septimont que lucha sin cadenas ni clemencia, es leal al ideal de la justicia.
target: Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, upholding the ideal of justice.

source: Un inquisiteur des Fractsidus qui détruit l'ordre avec ses flammes.
target: One of the Fractsidus Overseers. His blazing inferno engulfs all order and rules, leaving chaos in its wake.

source: Un membre des Gardiens de minuit.
target: A member of the Midnight Rangers.

source: Un membre fidèle du Fractsidus qui est capable de monter facilement de l'artillerie lourde.
target: Devoted followers of the Fractsidus, frequently collaborating with fellow Artificers. They can easily wield giant cannons.

source: Un miembro de Rangers de Medianoche.
target: A member of the Midnight Rangers.

source: Un mécha développé par le Collectif Trek-spatial, disponible en versions corps à corps et à distance. Les deux modèles combattent avec grâce en parfaite synchronisation lorsqu'ils sont associés.
target: A mech developed by the Spacetrek Collective, which comes in melee and ranged variants. The two models fight gracefully in unison when paired.

source: Un mécha noir, silencieux et égaré, qui aspire à retrouver son foyer.
target: A wordless black mech, lost and longing to return home.

source: Un mécha silencieux errant qui cherche toujours le chemin du retour.
target: A wordless black mech, lost and longing to return home.

source: Un nodo del sueño conectado a la Somnolencia, cuya frecuencia única atrae constantemente a las pesadillas cercanas.
target: A Dreamscape Node linked to the Somnoire, its unique frequency attracts nearby Nightmares.

source:
Un nodo del sueño conectado a la Somnolencia, cuya frecuencia única atrae constantemente a las pesadillas cercanas.
Elimina a las Disonancias Tácitas de pesadilla para obtener Ecos únicos.
target:
A Dreamscape Node linked to the Somnoire, its unique frequency attracts nearby Nightmares.
Suppress the Tacet Discords here to obtain unique Echoes.

source: Un nœud onirique relié au Somnoire. Ses fréquences singulières attirent continuellement les Cauchemars à proximité.
target: A Dreamscape Node linked to the Somnoire, its unique frequency attracts nearby Nightmares.

source:
Un nœud onirique relié au Somnoire. Ses fréquences singulières attirent continuellement les Cauchemars à proximité.
Vainquez les Tacets Discords de Cauchemar ici pour obtenir les Échos spéciaux.
target:
A Dreamscape Node linked to the Somnoire, its unique frequency attracts nearby Nightmares.
Suppress the Tacet Discords here to obtain unique Echoes.

source: Un poderoso Disonancia Tácita que reside en las profundidades de las Fauces del Tigre. Hay muy pocos informes de avistamientos disponibles, y los únicos que existen afirman que se asemejan a los insectos.
target: A powerful Tacet Discord that resides in the deep shafts of the Tiger's Maw. There is very few available sighting reports, and the only ones claim that they resemble insects.

source: Un puissant rapace, censé être éteint, réapparaît maintenant dans la Chambre de Vie Upphaf.
target: A powerful raptor believed to be extinct, now appearing within the Upphaf Life Chamber.

source: Un reno mecánico nacido de partes del Exotitán. Suele acompañar a los royas cuando extraen minerales.
target: A mechanical reindeer, grown from the Exostrider's own parts. They often help the Roya in ore mining.

source: Un reno mecánico nacido de partes del Exotitán. Suele acompañar a los royas cuando recolectan plantas.
target: A mechanical reindeer, grown from the Exostrider's own parts. They often help the Roya in plant foraging.

source: Un robot desarrollado por la Unión Intergaláctica para el cual existe modelo de combate cuerpo a cuerpo y a distancia. Ambos modelos luchan con gracia y hacen gala de una gran coordinación cuando están juntos.
target: A mech developed by the Spacetrek Collective, which comes in melee and ranged variants. The two models fight gracefully in unison when paired.

source: Un robot développé par le Collectif Trek-spatial, disponible en versions corps à corps et à distance. Les deux modèles combattent avec grâce en parfaite synchronisation lorsqu'ils sont associés.
target: A mech developed by the Spacetrek Collective, which comes in melee and ranged variants. The two models fight gracefully in unison when paired.

source: Un robot rápido de gran tamaño, útil por sus capacidades logísticas y defensivas. Fue desarrollado por la Unión Intergaláctica.
target: A large, fast-moving mech developed by the Spacetrek Collective for both transport and defense.

source: Un type de TD de classe Hurleur, largement répandu dans la nature. Les TD agissent en groupe et cette espèce est souvent à la tête de la charge.
target: A Common Class Howler TD widely distributed in the wild. Individuals often take actions in groups and this particular TD is often found to lead the charges.

source: Un Écho de l'Ordre qui manie un arc chargé de surveiller la ville de Ragunna et de rapporter les nouvelles à l'Ordre.
target: A bow-wielding Echo that resembles a statue, tasked with monitoring Ragunna City and reporting the details back to the Order.

source: Un Écho de l'Ordre sévère, maniant l'épée, chargé de protéger la paix et la sécurité de la ville de Ragunna.
target: A sword-wielding Echo that resembles a silent and stern statue, tasked with protecting Ragunna City's peace and safety for the Order.

source: Un Écho modifié par une technologie unique, transformé en une arme artificielle surarmée et née pour le combat.
target: A precise and powerful battle machine that has been refitted with special technology. It carries out its master's commands with absolute loyalty.

source: Un Écho sous l'apparence de dragon. Par quelque mystère, il réside à la pointe du Trépas du pénitent, dévorant sans distinction toutes les fréquences existantes
target: A dragon-like Tacet Discord that haunts the peak of Penitent's End for an unknown reason, devouring all frequencies indiscriminately.

source: Un être endormi sous l'océan, vestige de cendres d'une gloire éteinte depuis longtemps.
target: A being slumbering beneath the ocean, the ashen remains of a glory long burned out.

source: Una DT Aullido de Clase Común que frecuenta la naturaleza. Carga a velocidades increíbles.
target: A Common Class Howler TD that frequents the wild. It charges at incredible speeds.

source: Una DT Aullido de Clase común ampliamente distribuida en la naturaleza. Los individuos a menudo actúan en grupos y esta DT en particular a menudo se encuentra liderando las cargas.
target: A Common Class Howler TD widely distributed in the wild. Individuals often take actions in groups and this particular TD is often found to lead the charges.

source: Una DT Aullido de Clase común ampliamente distribuida en la naturaleza. Los individuos a menudo actúan en grupos y siguen al líder en las cargas.
target: A Common Class Howler TD widely distributed in the wild. Individuals often take actions in groups and follow the leader in charges.

source: Una DT Aullido de Clase de Marea que yace dormido bajo las Fauces del Tigre. Atrae a sus presas profundamente en la niebla en la que se esconde antes de capturarlas.
target: An Overlord Class Howler TD lying dormant under Tiger's Maw. It lures preys deep into the mist it hides in before capturing them.

source: Una DT Aullido de Clase de marea en el Bosque Oscuro. Con un tamaño gigante, se jacta de ser el soberano de esta tierra.
target: An Overlord Class Howler TD in Dim Forest. With a giant size, it boasts the sovereign of this land.

source: Una DT Aullido de Clase de élite encontrada en bosques y costas. Su naturaleza agresiva se muestra a menudo en sus movimientos tormentosos.
target: An Elite Class Howler TD found in forests and shores. Their aggressive nature is often shown in their stormy moves.

source: Una DT Aullido de Clase de élite que habita en el bosque. A menudo se encuentra en alta alerta.
target: An Elite Class Howler TD inhabiting the forest. It is often found on high alert.

source: Una DT Aullido de Clase de élite que se encuentra en bosques y costas. Su naturaleza agresiva se manifiesta a menudo en sus acciones estruendosas.
target: An Elite Class Howler TD found in forests and shores. Their aggressive nature is often manifested in their thunderous actions.

source: Una DT Aullido de Clase de élite que se esconde en las ruinas de la ciudad. Los Registros muestran que sus métodos especiales de camuflaje presentan grandes problemas para las personas que buscan identificarlo.
target: An Elite Class Howler TD hiding itself in city ruins. Records show that its special camouflage methods present great troubles for people looking to identify it.

source: Una DT Aullido de clase común. A pesar de sus alas, es completamente terrestre y muy sensible al frío.
target: A Common Class Howler TD. Despite its wings, it is entirely terrestrial and highly sensitive to the cold.

source: Una DT Aullido de clase común. Habita en áreas debajo de la tundra y es hábil en cavar extensos túneles subterráneos.
target: A Common Class Howler TD. It inhabits areas beneath the tundra and is skilled in digging extensive underground tunnels.

source: Una DT Aullido de la Clase de Tsunami en las profundidades del mar. Se registraron las melodías producidas por ella y se encontró que se asemejan a las canciones de las ballenas.
target: A Calamity Class Howler TD under the depths of the seas. Melodies produced by it were recorded and found to resemble whalesongs.

source: Una DT Cuchicheo de Clase común que frecuenta la naturaleza. Los Registros muestran que es capaz de tensar arcos como los humanos y disparar rayos como flechas.
target: A Common Class Whisperin TD that frequents the wilderness. Records show it is capable of pulling bowstrings like humans and shooting lightning as arrows.

source: Una DT Cuchicheo de clase común comúnmente encontrada en la naturaleza. Los Registros muestran que una guadaña gigante crece de su brazo.
target: A Common Class WhisperinTD commonly found in the wild. Records show that a giant scythe is grown from its arm.

source: Una DT Cuchicheo de clase común que frecuenta la naturaleza. Los Registros muestran que es capaz de reunir energía Gelio para formar un "proyectil" y lanzarlo como los humanos.
target: A Common Class WhisperinTD that frequents the wilderness. Records show it is able to gather Glacio energy to form a "projectile" and hurl it like humans.

source: Una DT Murmullo de Clase de élite a menudo visto en la naturaleza. Los Registros muestran que parece un instrumentista con una flauta en la mano.
target: An Elite Class Whisperin TD often seen in the wild. Records show it looks like an instrumentalist with a flute in hand.

source: Una DT Murmullo de Clase de élite con apariencia humanoide. Con un tamaño colosal como un monolito, usualmente es avistado en la naturaleza.
target: An Elite Class Whisperin TD with a humanoid appearance. With a colossal size like a monolith, it is usually spotted in the wild.

source: Una DT Murmullo de clase común ampliamente distribuida en la naturaleza. Su pequeño cuerpo es tan frágil como el hielo.
target: A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. Its small body is as fragile as ice.

source: Una DT Murmullo de la Clase de marea encontrada fuera de las Gargantas del Espíritu. Se sabe que es belicoso, malévolo y agresivo. Se necesita una observación más detallada para describir mejor a esta criatura.
target: An Overlord Class Whisperin TD found outside Gorges of Spirit. Known to be bellicose, malevolent, and aggressive. Further observation is needed to better picture this creature.

source: Una DT Murmullo de la clase de Marea escondido en las Llanuras Centrales. Demuestra habilidades de combate similares a las de un humano.
target: An Overlord Class Whisperin TD hidden in Central Plains. It demonstrates combat abilities similar to those of a human.

source: Una DT Staticoid de Clase común encontrada activo en la Ciudad portuaria de Guixu. Guarda similitud con artefactos de civilizaciones antiguas en la ciudad.
target: A Common Class Howler TD native to the Port City of Guixu. Records show it resembles objects from the city's lost civilization.

source: Una DT Staticoid que se esconde debajo de una instalación de Corte Jiting abandonada, su forma física se compone de un conglomerado de varios objetos. El nivel de riesgo se clasifica como Clase de marea.
target: A Staticoid TD that hides beneath an abandoned CSC facility, its physical form comprises a conglomerate of various objects. Threat level: Overlord Class.

source: Una DT de Aullido de Clase de élite escondido en las ruinas de la ciudad y a menudo camuflándose con vehículos de combate desechados.
target: An Elite Class Howler TD that hides itself in the Port City of Guixu. It disguises itself as an abandoned armored vehicle.

source: Una DT de Cuchicheo de Clase común ampliamente distribuida en la naturaleza. Puede manejar una pequeña cantidad de energía Aero para ataques.
target: A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Aero energy for attacks.

source: Una DT de Cuchicheo de Clase común ampliamente distribuida en la naturaleza. Puede manejar una pequeña cantidad de energía de Destrucción para ataques.
target: A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Havoc energy for attacks.

source: Una DT de Cuchicheo de Clase común ampliamente distribuida en la naturaleza. Puede manejar una pequeña cantidad de energía de Espectro para ataques.
target: A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Spectro energy for attacks.

source: Una DT de Cuchicheo de Clase común que frecuenta la naturaleza. Los Registros muestran que es capaz de reunir el viento como bumeranes para lanzar y atacar como los humanos.
target: A Common Class Whisperin TD that frequents the wilderness. Records show it is able to gather wind as boomerangs to toss and attack like humans.

source: Una DT de Cuchicheo de Clase común que se encuentra comúnmente en la naturaleza. Los Registros muestran que de su brazo crece una hoja afilada.
target: A Common Class Whisperin TD commonly found in the wild. Records show that a sharp blade is grown from its arm.

source: Una DT de Cuchicheo de la Clase de marea encontrada en las Tierras altas de Desoroca. Demuestra habilidades de combate similares a las de un humano.
target: An Overlord Class Whisperin TD found in Desorock Highland. It demonstrates combat abilities similar to those of a human.

source: Una DT de Murmullo de Clase de élite con apariencia humanoide. Con un tamaño colosal como una fortificación, usualmente es avistado en la naturaleza.
target: An Elite Class Whisperin TD with a humanoid appearance. With a colossal size like a fortification, it is usually spotted in the wild.

source: Una DT de Murmullo de la clase de Marea ubicado en la Ciudad Portuaria de Guixu. Los únicos registros existentes destacan un método de movimiento único de ella entre otros Disonancias Tácitas.
target: An Overlord Class Whisperin TD located in the Port City of Guixu. The only existing records noted a unique movement method of it among other Tacet Discords.

source: Una DT de la Clase de marea de Aullido aparece en las Tierras altas de Desoroca. Se sabe que es feroz y altamente agresivo.
target: An Overlord Class Howler TD showing up in Desorock Highland. It is known to be ferocious and highly aggresive.

source: Una DT de la Clase de marea de tipo Aullido que sobrevuela el Pantano de Aix. Surca los cielos mientras canta elegías, y ataca ferozmente a cualquier enemigo que se acerque.
target: An Overlord Class Howler TD hovering over Whining Aix's Mire. It soars the skies while singing elegies, and attacks fiercely any enemy that comes close.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita característica de las Llanuras Dimmr. Se la puede ver en áreas donde la contaminación por Materia de Vacío es severa. Presenta el aspecto de una polilla.
target: A unique, moth-like TD endemic to the Dimmr Plains, often seen in areas heavily contaminated by Voidmatter.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita con Calcita resonante en su espalda. La energía del Santuario del Nimbo tiene un brillo opalescente hipnotizante.
target: A rpck-mimic TD that carries Resonant Calcite. The Remnant Energy flowing inside shimmers with a pearly glow.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita con Engañoro en su espalda, que a menudo se confunde con un mineral de oro sin extraer, de superficie rugosa.
target: A rock-mimic TD with Fool's Gold on its back. It is often mistaken for unmined gold ore.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita con apariencia humana, vestida con ropas lujosas y empuñando una hoja afilada, aparece solo bajo el tenue brillo de la luna.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade. Seen only in the pale glow of the moon.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita con apariencia humana, vestida con ropas lujosas y empuñando una hoja afilada, posee una fuerza formidable, digna de las leyendas.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade and extraordinary might existing only in legends.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita con apariencia humana, vestida con ropas lujosas y empuñando una hoja afilada, solo aparece bajo la luz del día.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade. Seen only in the radiance of the sun.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita con forma de saurio, dotada de notables habilidades anfibias. Su piel está erizada de afiladas púas.
target: Fierce, amphibious Tacet Discords mimicking Saurosuchus. Named for the rows of horns covering their bodies.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita con la forma de cría de draco, cuyas garras y escamas arden con intensas llamas. De naturaleza social, suele vivir en grupos.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with flame blazing between its claws, often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita con la forma de cría de draco, cuyas garras y escamas emiten un resplandor cegador. De naturaleza social, suele vivir en grupos.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with light pulsating between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita con la forma de cría de draco, cuyas garras y escamas están envueltas en corrientes oscuras y misteriosas. De naturaleza social, suele vivir en grupos.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with ominous torrents sprawling between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de Pesadilla que da caza a Lucy. Puede desplazarse entre fisuras de datos.
target: A Nightmare Tacet Discord that is hunting down Lucy. It can traverse between data rifts.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de Tranquilidad de Clase común distribuida en áreas húmedas. Usualmente se le ve al lado de individuos más maduros.
target: A Common Class Tranquilite TD distributed in damp areas. Usually sighted beside maturer individuals.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de Tranquilidad de Clase común que a menudo se encuentra en la naturaleza. Su forma se asemeja a una piedra dorada.
target: A Common Class Tranquilite TD often found gathering in the wild. Its shape resembles a golden stone.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de Tranquilidad de Clase común que a menudo se encuentra en la naturaleza. Su forma se asemeja a una roca de lava.
target: A Common Class Tranquilite TD often found gathering in the wild. Its shape resembles a lava rock.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de Tranquilidad de Clase común que habita en áreas montañosas. A menudo se pasa por alto debido a su apariencia de roca.
target: A Common Class Tranquilite TD inhabiting mountainous areas. Often overlooked due to its rock-like appearance.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de Tranquilidad de Clase común que habita en áreas montañosas. A menudo se pasa por alto debido a su forma similar a la lava.
target: A Common Class Tranquilite TD inhabiting mountainous areas. Often overlooked due to its lava-like shape.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de Tranquilidad de Clase común que se encuentra a menudo en la naturaleza. Su forma se asemeja a un filón completamente oscuro.
target: A Common Class Tranquilite TD often found gathering in the wild. Its shape resembles a pitch-dark lode.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de Tranquilidad de Clase común que se encuentra a menudo en la naturaleza. Su forma se asemeja a un mineral de escarcha.
target: A Common Class Tranquilite TD often found gathering in the wild. Its shape resembles a frost ore.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de Tranquilidad de Clase de élite distribuida en los humedales. No hay registros que documenten intentos de movimiento voluntario de esta Disonancia Tácita.
target: An Elite Class Tranquilite TD distributed in the wetlands. No records have documented voluntary moving attempts of this TD.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de Tranquilidad de Clase de élite encontrada en áreas montañosas. Son de gran tamaño y habitan en las rocas.
target: An Elite Class Tranquilite TD found in mountainous areas. They bear huge sizes and inhabit rocks.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita de un ave espectral que aparece en Fin del Penitente, capaz de ocultarse en ambientes oscuros, dejando solo su cabeza ardiente flotando como una máscara, suspendida tenuemente como el fuego fatuo de las leyendas.
target: An avian Tacet Discord prowling the Penitent's End. In darkness, its form blends into shadow, leaving only its mask flickering like ignis fatuus.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita especial convocada por Phrolova desde una esfera integrada formada por frecuencias en descomposición conocidas como el más allá. Se manifiesta como la Bruja de Tres Caras del Inframundo.
target: A special Tacet Discord summoned by Phrolova from a Sonoro Sphere where all decaying frequencies converge, known as the "Beyond." It manifests as a three-faced Witch of the Underworld.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita especial que se oculta en la intrincada red de los nodos del sueño.
target: A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita especial que se oculta en la intrincada red de los nodos del sueño. Recolecta las frecuencias de cierta emoción negativa.
target: A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes. It gathers frequencies of a particular negative emotion.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita formada por vidrios coloreados, cuyos movimientos reflejan destellos deslumbrantes.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord with a body assembled from shattered stained glass. Glittering lights beam from its body with each move.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita humanoide de aspecto encorvado con fibras musculares rebosantes de corriente eléctrica y un apéndice en forma de látigo que emerge de su cabeza.
target: A bent-over humanoid Tacet Discord with electric currents coursing through its veins and a whip-like appendage on its head.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita humanoide que viste una falda gélida. Sus movimientos son gráciles y elegantes.
target: A graceful humanoid TD dressed in ice.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita humanoide sin rostro. Su cuerpo sombrío se desmiembra y ensambla con fluidez.
target: A faceless humanoid Tacet Discord with a body that flows, splits, and coalesces like a living shadow.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita mineral comúnmente encontrado en vetas de minas. Su cuerpo rocoso está saturado con abundante corriente de aire.
target: A mineral TD commonly found in mine veins, filled with powerful air currents.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita nacida del mar profundo con forma humana que imita a los caballeros aristocráticos, es una forma alternativa de la Actinia Primordial.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord born from the abyssal sea that assumes the semblance of an aristocratic knight, a fully differentiated form of Primordia Bloom.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita nacida del mar profundo, con forma humana que imita a la aristocracia, es una forma alternativa de la Actinia Primordial.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord born from the abyssal sea that assumes the semblance of an aristocrat, a fully differentiated form of Primordia Bloom.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita nacida del mar profundo, con forma humana que imita a los comerciantes aristocráticos, es una forma alternativa de la Actinia Primordial.
target: A humanoid Tacet Discord born from the abyssal sea that assumes the semblance of an aristocratic merchant, a fully differentiated form of Primordia Bloom.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita parasitaria que vive en el interior de otras de tipo Cuchicheo. Utiliza la coraza del huésped como crisálida y su cuerpo como fuente de nutrición.
target: A parasitic creature that lives inside Whisperin Tacet Discords. It uses the host's body as a cocoon and feeds on its frequency.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita parecida a un dragón acecha la cima de Fin del Penitente por razones desconocidas, devorando todas las frecuencias sin distinción.
target: A dragon-like Tacet Discord that haunts the peak of Penitent's End for an unknown reason, devouring all frequencies indiscriminately.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita que adopta la apariencia de un cofre de suministros, atrapa y devora a todos los seres humanos que deseen el tesoro extraordinario.
target: A deceptive Tacet Discord disguised as a supply chest, preying on the greed of its victims and devouring those who approach.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita que asume la función de la cabeza.
target: A Tacet Discord that functions as the "head" of Chop Chop.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita que asume la función de la mano derecha.
target: A Tacet Discord that functions as the "right hand" of Chop Chop.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita que asume la función de la mano izquierda.
target: A Tacet Discord that functions as the "left hand" of Chop Chop.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita que ataca a distancia en los Campos Tácitos.
target: A Tacet Discord that attacks targets at range within the Tacet Field.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita sin forma que se oculta en los peluches, busca captar los vítores y elogios de los humanos al imitar la apariencia de un peluche elegante y encantador.
target: An incorporeal Tacet Discord inhabiting the body of a charming, dashing plushie.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita sin forma que se oculta en los peluches, imita la apariencia de un peluche callado, pero atento en escuchar.
target: An incorporeal Tacet Discord inhabiting the body of a quiet, compassionate plushie.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita sin forma que se oculta en los peluches, imita la apariencia de un peluche trabajador.
target: An incorporeal Tacet Discord inhabiting the body of a sturdy, diligent plushie.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita sin forma que se oculta en los peluches, imita la figura de un peluche gigante, deteriorado y amenazante.
target: An incorporeal Tacet Discord inhabiting the body of a large, ragged stuffed toy.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita, con forma de cría de draco, lleva consigo chispas de trueno destellando entre sus garras. De naturaleza social, suele vivir en grupos.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with sparks of thunder flashing between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita, con forma de cría de draco, lleva consigo escarcha y hielo entre sus garras. De naturaleza social, suele vivir en grupos.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with ice and frost forming between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Una Disonancia Tácita, con forma de cría de draco, lleva consigo ráfagas de viento que danzan entre sus garras. De naturaleza social, suele vivir en grupos.
target: A TD that mimics a drake cub, with gusts of wind swirling between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.

source: Una clase común, terrestre, DT Aullido. Su tamaño dicta su poder limitado.
target: A common Class, terrestrial, Howler TD. Its size dictates its limited power.

source: Una criatura electromagnética blindada que atrae metales para formar una coraza protectora a su alrededor. A través de las grietas de su armadura metálica se vislumbran corrientes eléctricas.
target: A type of ironclad electromagnetic Murmurin TD that attracts metal to form a protective shell around itself. Electric arcs are faintly visible through cracks in its metallic armor.

source: Una criatura que acecha en las tierras altas, conocida por su naturaleza de cazador nómada.
target: A wolf-like Tacet Discord dominating high-altitude regions, notorious for its relentless predation.

source: Una criatura que asola las zonas devastadas por relámpagos, conocida por su naturaleza feroz y rápida.
target: A wolf-like Tacet Discord prowling storm-stricken regions, known for its aggressiveness and lightning speed.

source: Una criatura que merodea por las zonas heladas, conocida por su naturaleza fría y despiadada.
target: A wolf-like Tacet Discord ravaging frostbitten regions, known for its cold-blooded and ruthless nature.

source: Una de las «joyas» de los Fractsidus. Utilizando tecnología de la Nueva Federación, acoplaron un par de mangas ondulantes a una Disonancia Tácita.
target: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a pair of flowing sleeves with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.

source: Una de las «joyas» de los Fractsidus. Utilizando tecnología de la Nueva Federación, acoplaron un sombrero de ala ancha a una Disonancia Tácita.
target: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a picture hat with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.

source: Una de las «joyas» de los Fractsidus. Utilizando tecnología de la Nueva Federación, acoplaron unas zarpas temibles a una Disonancia Tácita.
target: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a set of vicious claws with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.

source: Una de los Centinelas en Huanglong que toma la forma de Loong. Con la habilidad de manipular el tiempo, Jué guía el desarrollo de la civilización de Jinzhou.
target: One of the Sentinels in Huanglong that takes the shape of Loong. With the ability to manipulate time, Jué guides the development of Jinzhou's civilization.

source: Una estudiante del Departamento de Materia de Vacío de la Academia Fuegostelar. En público, siempre la acompaña su «amable» sonrisa.
target: "A Department of Voidmatters student at Startorch Academy. Always there to flash her 'gentle' smile to one and all."

source: Una feroz Disonancia Tácita que imita a un oso. Sus garras golpean con fuerza de huracán.
target: A ferocious bear-mimic TD with great strength, swinging with hurricane-like force.

source: Una figura humanoide cubierta de barro oscuro, que permanece sentada en el campo de caza como presa, esperando el momento de devorar al cazador que se acerque.
target: A humanoid shell formed of black sludge. It takes its place among the prey, patiently awaiting the hunters it was made to devour.

source: Una forma especial de uno de los Supervisores de Fractsidus, que empuña un gran mandoble negro y hace trizas el orden y la ley.
target: A special form of one of the Fractsidus Overseers. Such monstrosity wields pitch-black scythe that cleaves through order and law.

source: Una gladiadora de Septimont que lucha sin cadenas ni clemencia, es leal a su feroz autoridad.
target: Gladiators of Septimont fight unrestrictedly, wielding stormborne might

source: Una gladiadora de Septimont que lucha sin cadenas ni clemencia, es leal a su indomable orgullo.
target: Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, bearing unyielding resolve.

source: Una gladiadora de Septimont que lucha sin cadenas ni clemencia, es leal a una verdad sin ego.
target: Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, believing in the doctrine of no-self.

source: Una miembro de Rangers de Medianoche.
target: A member of the Midnight Rangers.

source: Una poderosa Disonancia Tácita que aparece en el Sonoro en las Tierras altas de Desoroca. Capaz de usar poderes Electro.
target: A powerful Tacet Discord that appears in the Sonoro at Desorock Highlands. Capable of using Electro powers.

source: Una poderosa Disonancia Tácita ubicada en la Abundancia Abandonada. Según los testigos, su movimiento es diferente al de otros Disonancias Tácitas, se necesita más información para investigar más a fondo.
target: A powerful Tacet Discord located in the Port City of Guixu, According to witnesses, its movement is different from other Tacet Discords, more information to be further researched.

source: Une Exonuée puissante, ressemblant à un rapace, imite un ancien prédateur.
target: A mysterious raptor-shaped Exoswarm that seems to mimic an extinct ancient animal.

source: Une Jeunpierre mimétique portant de l'or des fous, que l'on confond souvent avec un filon d'or brut inexploité.
target: A rock-mimic TD with Fool's Gold on its back. It is often mistaken for unmined gold ore.

source: Une Jeunpierre mimétique portant de la Calcite résonnante, où l'énergie des nuages ondule comme des reflets nacrés aux mille facettes.
target: A rpck-mimic TD that carries Resonant Calcite. The Remnant Energy flowing inside shimmers with a pearly glow.

source: Une coquille humanoïde façonnée dans la vase noire. Dissimulée parmi les proies, elle attend patiemment le moment de dévorer les chasseurs qui viendront.
target: A humanoid shell formed of black sludge. It takes its place among the prey, patiently awaiting the hunters it was made to devour.

source: Une création des Fractsidus. Un échec défectueux, abandonné dans les ombres.
target: A creation of the Fractsidus. A defective failure abandoned to the shadows.

source: Une création dont les Fractsidus tirent une immense fierté. En utilisant les technologies de la Nouvelle Fédération, ils ont combiné des griffes vicieuses aux qualités des Tacets Discords pour créer une créature cruelle.
target: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a set of vicious claws with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.

source: Une création dont les Fractsidus tirent une immense fierté. En utilisant les technologies de la Nouvelle Fédération, ils ont combiné des manches flottantes aux qualités des Tacets Discords pour créer cette créature vicieuse.
target: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a pair of flowing sleeves with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.

source: Une créature mutante qui est le chef des Houlices dans la Forêt aveuglante.
target: A formidable Mutant Organism that appears in the deep of Dim Forest. Leader of the Hoochiefs.

source: Une créature parasitaire vivant à l'intérieur des Tacet Discords Chuchoteurs qui utilise le corps de l'hôte comme un cocon et se nourrit de sa fréquence.
target: A parasitic creature that lives inside Whisperin Tacet Discords. It uses the host's body as a cocoon and feeds on its frequency.

source: Une des innombrables créatures vestigiales du Nimbus à l'origine, elle reçut la conscience par le pouvoir divin d'Imperator. Sa mission était d'absorber et de purifier les fréquences corrompues qui infestaient le Nimbus.
target: Once a remnant creature in Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.

source: Une fois ce Tacet Discord vaincu, des contaminations de fréquence affecteront la zone, rendant impossible le déploiement d'un appareil dans la zone contaminée, et l'appareil déployé sera désactivé.
target: This Tacet Discord releases Frequency Contamination on the spot when defeated. Combat Machines cannot be deployed on contaminated grids, and deployed Combat Machines on these grids become disabled.

source: Une forme particulière de l'un des inquisiteurs de Fractsidus, maniant une immense épée noire capable de briser tout ordre établi et de défier la loi.
target: A special form of one of the Fractsidus Overseers. Such monstrosity wields pitch-black scythe that cleaves through order and law.

source: Une grande créature mutant cachée dans Yunling-la-Vallée. Extrême dangereuse et on n'a pas encore de document détaillé sur ce TD.
target: Large Mutant Organism that hides itself in the depths of the Gorges of Spirits. It is only reasonable to decide that it is of extreme danger as of now, since now detailed record exist that depicts the whole appearance of it.

source: Une machine capable de se camoufler qui est capable de traque les mouvements ennemis en utilisant le détecteur situé à l'extrémité de sa queue.
target: A machine capable of camouflage. It possesses heightened senses and uses the detector on its tail to track enemy movements.

source: Une machine prédatrice qui attaque tout sur son passage. Elle rôde dans les terres sauvages de Lahai-Roi, traquant le moindre signe de mouvement.
target: A highly aggressive predatory machine that prowls the wilderness of Lahai-Roi, hunting any sign of movement.

source: Une silhouette cachée dans les Ateliers célestes. Oubliée depuis longtemps, elle continue d'accomplir sa mission d'épuration sans relâche.
target: A ruined giant shadow lurking within the Skyworks. It has nearly been forgotten, yet still clings to the directive to wipe out the Tacet Discords to the bitter end.

source: Une statue qui symbolise l'adoration des gens de Ragunna à l'Ordre.
target: A statue-like Echo that symbolizes mercy and compassion, always listening to Ragunnesi's prayers and praises to the Order.

source: Une technicienne qui se trouve souvent dans le camp des exilés et est responsable de la réparation des armes.
target: Technician members of the Exiles, commonly found in Exile Campgrounds. They are in charge of the repairing and making of weapons and equipment.

This Tacet Discord has higher Electro RES.
